name: ANSI/IEEE High-speed relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of high-speed relay: a high-speed relay has a documented operating response intended for duties where relay timing matters.
description: This reference locates high-speed relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented relays and contacts family. A high-speed relay has a documented operating response intended for duties where relay timing matters. Schematics need the specific model and circuit role rather than an unqualified speed claim. The public library uses HCR1HSP for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Read operate and release times under the specified coil and contact conditions. High-speed classification does not imply a complete protection scheme's total clearing time. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
